reader_notes: Paragraph 4 made me backtrack: it opens with 'Näversved invänder mot sina egna beräkningar' plus a quote from him, then switches to 'Det argumentet kan jag inte räkna bort' without a break. On first read I briefly attributed that 'jag' to Näversved rather than to the writer.

First person appears exactly once in the whole piece, in that one paragraph; the rest is impersonal. For a signed debattartikel that is a slightly uneven voice, though not confusing once the byline is reached.

The numbers all reconcile (61 pupils = 58 at stops already served + 3 on two spur roads; 44 applications, 27 granted; four kronor in five fixed), which is what made q1 easy to settle: 90 000 against 1,4 miljoner is a fraction, not zero, so the 'inte en enda krona' option is properly excluded.
q1 option A ('behövs, men först vid nästa upphandling') is the thinnest of the four — it corresponds to no position actually stated in the text.
